title: Shaastra (technical festival)
summary: IIT Madras's technical festival: events, competitions, organising team, departments.

posts.md:
Shaastra is the **annual technical festival of IIT Madras**.

Entirely student-managed, Shaastra was the **first student-run technical festival in the world** to receive the **ISO 9001:2015 certification** for implementing a **Quality Management System**.

Over the years, it has grown into one of India's largest and most reputed techno-managerial festivals, bringing together students, researchers, industry leaders, and innovators from across the country and abroad.

## Events at Shaastra

The festival consists of a wide range of:

- Engineering, Science, and Technology Competitions
- Summits
- Lectures
- Exhibitions
- Demonstrations
- Workshops
- Interactive Events

Every edition of Shaastra serves as a platform to showcase cutting-edge innovations and foster collaboration between academia and industry.

## Competitions & Participation

The competitions at Shaastra are known for attracting one of the **highest numbers of outstation participants** among technical festivals in India.

Students from institutions across the globe participate in various competitions and events.

Through its initiatives, Shaastra continues to receive recognition and appreciation from industry, academia, and the media.

## Organising Team

Team Shaastra is headed by the **Co-Curricular Affairs Secretary** along with the **Shaastra Core Team**.

Hundreds of students work throughout the year across different departments to organise the **five-day festival**, making it one of the **largest completely student-run events** in the country.

## Shaastra Departments

Shaastra currently consists of several verticals and departments, including:

- Sponsorship & Public Relations
- Evolve
- Envisage
- Events & Workshops
- Design, Ambience & Media
- Finance
- Operations & Infrastructure Planning
- Publicity
- Quality Management System
- Shows & Exhibitions
- Web Operations

## Looking Ahead

In recent years, Shaastra has expanded its focus towards:

- Emerging Technologies
- Innovation-driven Initiatives
- International Collaborations

These efforts continue to strengthen Shaastra's position as one of the leading student-run technical festivals in the country.
